messages.subject: Geom_taxalink with a circular tree
parts:
Hello,

I'm trying to use the geom_taxalink but with a circular tree. In a standard tree the code works fine, but when converting to a circular layout I get the error:
 geom_curve is not implemented for non-linear coordinates
I've tried removing coord_polar() as well as trying a variety of other coordinate systems but none seem to get the result I'm looking for.

Code:

tree <- read.tree("rimosus_core_tree_branch_lengths.txt")
tree

ggtree(tree, layout = "circular") + scale_x_reverse() + geom_treescale(x=0) + coord_polar(theta = "y") + geom_taxalink("GCF_000716515.1_ASM71651v1_genomic", "GCF_001507395.1_ASM150739v1_genomic", color = "blue3")
